description: This file defines a React component named 'CookingMode' that manages the cooking process UI, including fetching a recipe, displaying steps, controlling a timer, and integrating browser APIs like speech synthesis and wake lock.

methods.name: CookingMode()
methods.description: React functional component for managing and displaying the cooking steps, timer, and speech synthesis.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next recipe step and invokes speech synthesis for the step.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Goes back to the previous recipe step.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Uses the Web Speech API to read aloud the current step.
